standard-dialogue.npc: Hey, human, can you do me a favour? That Librarian won't help me find a book.

options.text: Sure, what book do you want?

steps.player: Sure, what book do you want?
I'll see what I can do.

steps.npc: I'm from the Stronghold. Mostly I teach magic, and stuff like that. Anyway, I heard they'd got magic here unlike anything I'd ever seen, so I came to learn what I could.
It'd really help with my learning if you'd find my book for me. Will you?

standard-dialogue-while-finding-a-book-f.npc: Have you found my book, human? '[book name]'
If you do, I bet the Arceuus citizens will be grateful for you helping their customers. They must know their Librarian's useless.
Aren't you helping someone else at the moment? Don't let me interrupt.

standard-dialogue-turning-in-the-book.npc: Thanks, human. You can have this other book that I don't want.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-them-after-.npc: Thanks for finding my book. I'm learning such a lot here.
